sources.title: Combatting adversarial distillation
sources.title_en: Combatting adversarial distillation
sources.title_original: Combatting adversarial distillation
sources.summary:
OpenAI’s layered approach to adversarial distillation combines model training, safeguards, detection, and enforcement to protect against capability extraction.
OpenAI’s layered approach to adversarial distillation combines model training, safeguards, detection, and enforcement to protect against capability extraction.
OpenAI’s layered approach to adversarial distillation combines model training, safeguards, detection, and enforcement to protect against capability extraction.
November 20, 2026
Ho
sources.recommend_reason_zh: OpenAI 介绍其对抗 adversarial distillation 的分层防护，并称 GPT‑6.2 Astra 与 GPT‑6.2 Sol 已强化 protected reasoning 防护，内部红队评估平均攻击成功率从 54.0% 降至 0.2%。

en.reason: OpenAI’s layered defenses against adversarial distillation, spanning model training, safeguards, detection and enforcement, cut internal red-team average attack success from 54.0% to 0.2% for GPT‑6.2 Astra and GPT‑6.2 Sol’s protected reasoning.

stories.title: 欢迎 Inkling 2 Mini，为你的本地部署带来前沿性能 / Welcome Inkling 2 Mini, Cutting-edge Performance for your Local Setup

sources.title: 欢迎 Inkling 2 Mini，为你的本地部署带来前沿性能 / Welcome Inkling 2 Mini, Cutting-edge Performance for your Local Setup
sources.title_zh: 欢迎 Inkling 2 Mini，为你的本地部署带来前沿性能
sources.title_en: Welcome Inkling 2 Mini, Cutting-edge Performance for your Local Setup
sources.title_original: Welcome Inkling 2 Mini, Cutting-edge Performance for your Local Setup
sources.summary:
We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
TLDR; Inkling 2 Mini is a new looped transformer model. It’s a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts with ~26B physical total and 3B active parameters per token. It uses a neat trick to increase capacity: some layers are visited in a loop that repeats three times, which makes it work like it
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章拆解 Inkling 2 Mini 如何用 24 层中 12 层循环三次、等效 48 次层访问，做到约 26B 物理参数、每 token 仅 3B 激活，并支持 1M token 上下文与图文输入，面向本地部署。

en.reason: Inkling 2 Mini is a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts looped transformer with about 26B physical parameters but only 3B active per token, looping 12 of 24 layers three times for 48 equivalent layer visits, 1M-token context, and local deployment.

stories.title: OpenAI 让攻击者更难窥探其最新 AI 模型是如何思考的 / OpenAI makes it much harder for attackers to extract how its latest AI models think

sources.title: OpenAI 让攻击者更难窥探其最新 AI 模型是如何思考的 / OpenAI makes it much harder for attackers to extract how its latest AI models think
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 让攻击者更难窥探其最新 AI 模型是如何思考的
sources.title_en: OpenAI makes it much harder for attackers to extract how its latest AI models think
sources.title_original: OpenAI makes it much harder for attackers to extract how its latest AI models think
sources.summary:
OpenAI has significantly strengthened safeguards against extracting internal reasoning from GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol. In adaptive red-teaming tests, the success rate for extracting protected reasoning fell from 54 percent to 0.2 percent. The company is also suspending thousands to tens of thousands of accounts each week over coordinated distillation campaigns.

en.reason: OpenAI reduced successful extraction of protected internal reasoning from GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol from 54% to 0.2% in adaptive red-teaming tests and suspends thousands to tens of thousands of accounts weekly for coordinated distillation campaigns.

en.title: Damn — former Google CEO Eric Schmidt just spent 27 seconds laying out the easiest route to getting rich over the next two years. Making money, it turns out, is simple: start an agentic AI company, build an agent that can actually do real work, and own the whole thing yourself. From prompts, memory and skills to MCP, plus dev tools like Claude Code, one person can hand-build a company inside the one-to-two-year window. But after spending my days lately wrangling every kind of Agent workflow, I've grown increasingly clear-eyed: plenty of people are working themselves ragged building memory into AI, …
en.summary: Former Google CEO Eric Schmidt just spent 27 seconds laying out the easiest path to wealth over the next two years: making money is actually simple—found an agentic AI company, build an Agent that can truly get things done, and own it entirely yourself. From prompts, memory, and skills to MCP, plus development tools like Claude Code, one person can build a company by hand during the one-to-two-year window. But after constantly tinkering with various Agent workflows lately, I've become increasingly clear-eyed: many people desperately build memory for AI, connect tools, and pile on compute, yet forget that the underlying hardware running all code and wealth is their own body. The golden window is only one or two years. If you stay up late every night, survive on takeout, and have no clue how your blood lipids and blood sugar change on your checkup report, then no matter how fast the Agent runs, your body will crash first, and then...
en.reason: Former Google CEO Eric Schmidt’s 27-second path to wealth in the next two years centers on founding an agentic AI company you fully own, built solo with prompts, memory, skills, MCP and tools like Claude Code, while the piece warns that late nights, takeout and unchecked blood lipids and glucose can crash your body before your agent ships.

en.title: What makes Anthropic worth $1.77 trillion?

en.title: The No. 1 spot on the search rankings is... Amazon?
en.summary:
The top spot on the search leaderboard is Amazon??

Latest LMArena search arena rankings
Based on more than 1.5 million real human votes
No. 1: Amazon-Web-Search-Agent, 1,266 points
No. 2: Qwen3.8-Max, 1,261 points
No. 3: GPT-5.6 Sol, 1,256 points

GPT has been pushed down to third
Qwen is just 5 points from first — 5 points!!
The real question is where this No. 1 came from
It's not a flagship model at all
It's a dedicated search agent Amazon trained in-house
It only went public on November 18
And debuted straight at the top
Most ironic of all, Amazon said so itself in its post
The same search stack, paired with Claude Opus 4.6, scores 1,273
Higher than its own agent's 1,2…

en.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon for robot control, simulation, and policy optimization
en.reason: Google's Gemini 4 Argon, a general physical reasoning model for embodied tasks, scores 87% pure reasoning on the ERQA benchmark and lifts real-world task success from 56% to 75%, while supporting robot control, Real2Sim reconstruction, video annotation and policy optimization.

stories.title: 大型企业和银行落地 AI 智能体，宁可推进慢半拍，也绝不交出私有数据与业务控制权。 今早在新加坡金融科技节（SFF 2026）上，华为推出面向银行的“双超级智能体”方案，核心直指企业从试点走向生产必须锁死自有知识与逻辑；同日新发的 Phai-A1 也把百万上下文塞进个人电脑，单卡编码快 8 到 10 倍。 落地启示：给企业做工作流交付，主打“本地轻量模型+私有数据不出内网”，签单最痛快。 #企业AI #本地大模型 #工作流优化

stories.title: AI 的记忆在帮我，也好像困住了我

sources.title: AI 的记忆在帮我，也好像困住了我
sources.title_zh: AI 的记忆在帮我，也好像困住了我
sources.title_original: AI 的记忆在帮我，也好像困住了我
sources.summary: AI记忆带来便捷的同时，也暗藏困住人的风险。作者因写入“小白讲师”标签，导致AI持续把机会局限在培训赛道，不断强化刻板印象，甚至让自己慢慢认同这个单一身份。这篇思考给高频使用 Agent 的人也敲了警钟，提醒我们在人机共生中，别让 AI 的记忆框住自己更多潜在方向。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 每天用AI记忆，因‘小白讲师’标签只收到培训建议；AI查半导体国产替代6个环节、约50家公司，结论只剩国产GPU开发者生态和请外部讲师两个口子，反思记忆框住自我。

en.title: AI memory is helping me — and also seems to trap me
en.summary: AI memory brings convenience, but it also carries a hidden risk of trapping people. After the author added a "novice lecturer" tag, the AI kept limiting opportunities to the training track, reinforcing the stereotype and even leading the author to gradually identify with this single identity. This reflection is a warning for heavy Agent users: in human-AI coexistence, don't let AI's memory box in your broader potential.

en.title: How do you test AI visibility in GEO? Recording cards as a case study
en.summary: To find out whether AI will proactively recommend your product, this reusable AI visibility testing method is worth a look. Using Notta Memo’s overseas market test as a case study and drawing on NIST and IAB industry standards, the author explains prompt design, variable control, result evaluation, baseline retention, and retesting logic, with a logging template included.
en.reason: Using Notta Memo's US-English launch as a case study, the piece lays out a reusable GEO testing method built on NIST and IAB standards, covering prompt design, variable control, distinguishing brand mentions from product recommendations, and baseline logs for retesting.

en.title: For everyone saying GPT6.2 is no good, Lao Jin has a secret playbook

sources.title_original: Grab 通过安全策略应对 AI 生成代码变更激增，提升移动端 App 稳定性
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Grab 为应对 AI 编程加速带来的崩溃风险，搭建覆盖 Android Lint、SwiftLint、GEA 预生产门禁和分阶段发布的分层防御，以左移策略在合并前拦截问题。

en.title: Grab uses security policies to tackle a surge in AI-generated code changes, boosting mobile app stability
en.reason: Grab built a layered, left-shifted defense across its mobile release lifecycle—using Android Lint and SwiftLint before merge plus GEA pre-production gates and staged rollout—to prevent, detect and isolate crashes as AI-assisted coding inflates per-release code changes.

2027 越来越近，AI 时代进入深水区，很多人还没意识到游戏规则已经改写了。

过去二十年，普通人靠“写代码、做设计、跑运营、靠勤奋和脑力”就能在互联网浪潮里撬动杠杆；但接下来，当 AI 把基础脑力活和大量执行层变成近乎零成本的“水电煤”，真正的掌局者正在从“劳动力”转向“资本与算力/物理资产”。

不是世界没有机会了，而是旧地图已经找不到新大陆。

1. 脑力与体力劳动，正在被双重边缘化

基础脑力劳动加速贬值：文案、初级代码、常规分析、基础设计，AI 跑得比人快、成本低得多。单纯靠“熟练工”式的脑力输出，护城河正在迅速消失。

en.title: 2027 is drawing closer, the AI era is moving into deep waters, and many people have yet to realize that the rules of the game have already been rewritten.
en.summary:
2027 is closing in, the AI era has entered deep waters, and many people still haven't realized the rules of the game have already been rewritten.

For the past two decades, ordinary people could gain leverage in the internet wave by "writing code, doing design, running operations, and relying on hard work and brainpower." But from here on, as AI turns basic cognitive work and much of the execution layer into near-zero-cost "utilities," the real power holders are shifting from "labor" to "capital and compute/physical assets."

It's not that the world has run out of opportunities — it's that the old map can no longer find the new continent.

1. Cognitive and physical labor are being marginalized on two fronts

Basic cognitive labor is depreciating fast: copywriting, entry-level code, routine analysis, basic design — AI does it faster and far cheaper. A moat built purely on "skilled worker"-style cognitive output is rapidly disappearing.

en.title: 2027 is drawing closer, the AI era is moving into deep waters, and many people have yet to realize that the rules of the game have already been rewritten.
en.summary:
2027 is closing in, the AI era has entered deep waters, and many people still haven't realized the rules of the game have already been rewritten.

For the past two decades, ordinary people could gain leverage in the internet wave by "writing code, doing design, running operations, and relying on hard work and brainpower." But from here on, as AI turns basic cognitive work and much of the execution layer into near-zero-cost "utilities," the real power holders are shifting from "labor" to "capital and compute/physical assets."

It's not that the world has run out of opportunities — it's that the old map can no longer find the new continent.

1. Cognitive and physical labor are being marginalized on two fronts

Basic cognitive labor is depreciating fast: copywriting, entry-level code, routine analysis, basic design — AI does it faster and far cheaper. A moat built purely on "skilled worker"-style cognitive output is rapidly disappearing.

Traditional physical and standardized execution work is under pressure: automation, robots, and unmanned equipment keep pushing into…

en.title: Six stories from the past 24 hours, all verified against official sources—these are all you need to start with.
en.summary:
All six of these from the past 24 hours have been checked against official sources—here's all you need for now.

1. Gemini's computer use is now available in the Gemini app on Mac. The official blog says you can describe what you want done, and Gemini will click, type, navigate menus and fill out forms on its own in an isolated background window while your main screen and cursor remain yours. A live preview runs in the chat; you choose which apps it can use, pause it at any time, and approve key actions. Official examples include batch color grading or building 3D scenes, extracting information from local PDFs to fill out shipping rate forms, pulling data and screenshots from dashboards across multiple regions to build Google Slides, and batch-listing local photos. Rolling out starting today in the US, in English, in the Gemini Mac app; requires Apple Silicon and macOS Seq…
en.reason: Gemini's Mac app now runs computer use in an isolated background window—clicking, typing and filling forms while your screen and cursor stay yours—with approval before key actions; US English rollout starts today on Apple Silicon, per official blog.

en.summary:
All six of these from the past 24 hours have been checked against official sources—here's all you need for now.

1. Gemini's computer use is now available in the Gemini app on Mac. The official blog says you can describe what you want done, and Gemini will click, type, navigate menus and fill out forms on its own in an isolated background window while your main screen and cursor remain yours. A live preview runs in the chat; you choose which apps it can use, pause it at any time, and approve key actions. Official examples include batch color grading or building 3D scenes, extracting information from local PDFs to fill out shipping rate forms, pulling data and screenshots from dashboards across multiple regions to build Google Slides, and batch-listing local photos. Rolling out starting today in the US, in English, in the Gemini Mac app; requires Apple Silicon and macOS Seq…
